plugins.name: pulseengine-claude
plugins.description: PulseEngine methodology as installable Claude Code tooling — philosophy + toolchain + repo-taxonomy + prose-conventions + generated-media + model-operating-contract memory, memory-persistence hooks (situational awareness at session start, working-context checkpoints across sessions/compaction), a session-start hook that sets zsh no_nomatch and no_equals for the agent's Bash calls, a non-blocking PreToolUse hook that reminds the agent to choose `model:` on an Agent call that would inherit the parent's model, plus twenty-four procedural skills (clean-room verification, release execution with a V-model traceability gate, oracle-gating, the full feature loop, the standardized release-artifact pipeline, tool-friction reporting, session-learning capture, STPA/STPA-Sec hazard-analysis audit, backend-agnostic proof synthesis, full bidirectional traceability audit across the V, greenfield verification bootstrap, release planning with an issue-driven delivery loop, an incremental issue-hunt loop, a quiesce-gated post-release repo-hygiene sweep, a gate-potency audit that proves standing CI checks can still fail, a self-claim check for assertions that reach further than the instrument behind them, and an evidence-transfer check for the sibling class where a green, non-vacuous, TRUE result is about the wrong machine, a cost-tiered delegation rule that names `model:` on every Agent call and sends mechanical work with an exact check to the cheapest tier, since delegated work is mostly cache reads, and escalates only on a mechanical failure, a CI-status check that asks the fleet's status API before polling GitHub and falls back to gh pr checks when the API is not configured, and a publication review that gates blog posts and other public prose on a cold domain-expert, fact-checker and editor panel, blocking on any refuted quote, number or citation, and a factory notice inbox through which unattended agents report shipped, blocked and session summaries and post decisions as option dialogues, accepting only an offered option at the current revision, once, and a refactor decision that says when to stop patching and refactor, records a none/small/large decision and requires behaviour-preservation evidence, excluded from pulseengine/rivet and pulseengine/spar until 2027-02-01 for a pre-registered experiment, and a seam contract that writes the interface between two repos as a ```seam block in the owning issue, with an owner repo on each side, dated decisions and an owner for every open question, and checks it with seam-check.py against the provider's files, exiting 1 on drift and 2 when it cannot read the evidence).
